title: Adaptive Regional Functional Regression
text: R + RcppArmadillo · scalar--function regression · explicit validation AdaReFun short Adaptive Regional Functional Regression. provides adaptive regional sparsity methods scalar--function linear regression contains established fixed-resolution fMCP() fSCAD() estimators together proposed adaptive regional framework: ASR-MCP ASR-SCAD: adaptive single-resolution regional penalties; AMR-MCP AMR-SCAD: adaptive multi-resolution regional penalties; arfc(): one specified ASR/AMR MCP/SCAD fit, training BIC supplied tuning path; arfc_select(): independent-validation selection exactly one four fits. ARFC adaptive regional folded-concave estimator family. ARFC-Select chooses one four members validation MSE. package also provides fixed-resolution fMCP() fSCAD() fits. model Yi=μ+∫Xi(t)β(t)dt+εi, Y_i = \mu + \int X_i(t)\beta(t)\,dt + \varepsilon_i, response YiY_i paired curve Xi(t)X_i(t) common argument domain, μ\mu intercept, β(t)\beta(t) coefficient function, εi\varepsilon_i residual error. coefficient uses common B-spline representation. regional penalty uses normalized regional norms domain-mass multipliers. multi-resolution fit, nested regions share coefficient vector level weights sum one. Matrix-intensive integration, regional Gram construction, norm evaluation, local quadratic approximation, tuning-path fitting, active-set refitting, effective degrees freedom, BIC calculations implemented C++17 RcppArmadillo.
